name: Eternals' Path
storyline:
Eternals’ Path is a 2D turn-based rogue-like RPG about reincarnation and past-lives choices, in a colorful and mysterious Afterlife.

During your journey, you'll meet people you once knew, talk with them and repent from past mistakes, or on the contrary, face them and impose your version of the facts.

Narration is tied with the gameplay, with dialogues impacting the upcoming fights, as well as your statistics! Manage your Humanity as a double-edged sword, both a ressource and a weapon. Gather Memories from past lives, and craft a unique build with more than 20 skills to unlock.

And finally, escape towards your reincarnation !
summary: Eternals’ Path is a roguelike, tactical turn-based RPG about struggles and poor choices you made and had during your life that will haunt you in death. Incarnate anti-heroes through different places. Fight those who wander there, but also people you knew in your life with lots of grievances to share
